title: Sapling - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Sapling in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One of the most defensive profiles in the game: four elements resisted and Dark absorbed. Light is the only clean answer.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight
ResistsFire, Ice, Earth, Lightning
AbsorbsDark
ImmuneNone

Bring Light damage. Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning is resisted, so those turns are wasted. Dark is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Sapling
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Dark, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
  • It resists Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning, so that damage is halved.
